title: pvComputeSides
body:
## pvComputeSides

Adds arrays to a cell grid (vtkCellGrid) listing the unshared sides of its cells, i.e. external surfaces and non-conforming internal interfaces, as (cell id, side id) pairs grouped by cell type and side shape. ParaView's cell-grid representation uses these arrays to render the grid efficiently; the cells themselves are unchanged. Use it when preparing cell grids from pvConvertToCellGrid for rendering or boundary extraction.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The cell types must implement VTK's sides query; ordinary datasets need pvConvertToCellGrid first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ComputeSides`. Identity: `filters/ComputeCellGridSides`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. Accepted data: cell grids (discontinuous Galerkin cells) (vtkCellGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCellGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OmitSidesForRenderableInputs` | Set this property to true to avoid generating sides for input cells or sides that can be rendered as they are. If false, then sides will be output even for cells/sides that are surfaces or edges. As an example, if an input has hexahedra and triangle cells, this filter will generate quadrilateral sides (for the hexahedra) and edge sides (for the triangles) if OmitSidesForRenderableInputs is true, but only quadrilateral sides (for the hexahedra) if OmitSidesForRenderableInputs is false. Note that this is independent of whether some input cells are preserved or not. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PreserveRenderableInputs` | Set this property to true to include the original input cells in the output if they are of dimension 2 or lower (i.e., surface, edges, or vertices). If false, then only the computed sides will be output. As an example, if an input has hexahedra and triangle cells, this filter will output quadrilateral sides and triangle cells when PreserveRenderableInputs is true and only quadrilateral sides when PreserveRenderableInputs is false. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SidestoInclude` | Which sides are computed, by dimension. Next Lowest Dimension gives faces of volume cells, edges of surface cells and end points of edge cells; Surfaces of Inputs only faces of volume cells; Edges of Inputs the edges of volume and surface cells; Vertices of Inputs the corner points of all cells; All Sides every combination. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Surfaces of Inputs","Edges of Inputs","Vertices of Inputs","All Sides","Next Lowest Dimension"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Surfaces of Inputs"` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvComputeSides",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
